This small plot is for my tubers mixed with other crops, so I will manage it mainly with the rainfall and the family work I can still organize. Fertilizer and chemicals cost money, and for a plot this small I would rather use some manure or compost if I can get it and plant the seed I normally keep or source locally. I do not plan to irrigate, and I will only bring in a little outside help if the work becomes too heavy for me.
